name: Freed
summary: Ambient AI scribe for clinicians, with coding, evidence answers and a front-desk product.
description: Freed writes clinical notes from visits and works with browser-based EHRs, adding visit preparation, cited clinical evidence, letters and ICD-10, CPT and E/M code suggestions. A separate front-desk product offers an AI receptionist. A free trial is offered; scribe plans start at $39 per month and front-desk plans at $149 per month. The company states it is trusted by more than 26,000 clinicians.
